description: A meme image with impact text above and below. Always flagged for manual review - comedy is never placed unchecked.

fields.name: top
fields.label: Top text
fields.description: Impact text across the top of the image.

fields.name: bottom
fields.label: Bottom text
fields.description: Impact text across the bottom of the image.

fields.name: text_size
fields.label: Text size
fields.description: Multiplier on the impact text, measured from the image rather than the frame, so it looks the same on a small meme and a large one. Big type wraps onto more lines instead of shrinking back to fit two, so the setting holds even on a long line; it stops growing once the text fills the picture.

fields.name: top_x
fields.label: Top text X
fields.description: Where the top line sits across the image, 0 flush left and 1 flush right. Always clamped against the text's own measured size, so either end of the slider still lands the whole line inside the picture.

fields.name: top_y
fields.label: Top text Y
fields.description: Where the top line sits down the image, 0 flush with the top edge and 1 with the bottom. Always clamped against the text's own measured size, so either end of the slider still lands the whole line inside the picture.

fields.name: bottom_x
fields.label: Bottom text X
fields.description: Where the bottom line sits across the image, 0 flush left and 1 flush right. Always clamped against the text's own measured size, so either end of the slider still lands the whole line inside the picture.

fields.name: bottom_y
fields.label: Bottom text Y
fields.description: Where the bottom line sits down the image, 0 flush with the top edge and 1 with the bottom. Always clamped against the text's own measured size, so either end of the slider still lands the whole line inside the picture.
